about.hero.title: Black Cat Glass
about.hero.lead: Black Cat Glass is a small indie game dev studio currently focused on Kiddo, with older public prototypes like cyberpunk-shootout showing the road here.
about.mission.heading: What we make
about.mission.subheading: Dark game projects built by a small team.
about.mission.body1: The studio is shaped around compact, playable experiments: systems-first games, moody spaces, and ideas that feel a little hostile in the best way.
about.mission.body2: Public pages only show projects and information meant to be shared. Internal repositories, revenue, and business plans stay off the site.

about.quote: “Personality experiment. It may not like you, and you may not like it. For games, we want that same uneasy energy: playable, dark, and a little sharp.”
about.quote.author: Black Cat Glass
